column1: # Bridges and half-space walks on Z^3 (reference values).
#  b_n : n-step bridges, 0 = x1(w_0) < x1(w_i) <= x1(w_n) for 0 < i <= n, n = 1..28: Clisby, Conway, Guttmann,
#        "Three-dimensional terminally attached self-avoiding walks and bridges", J. Phys. A 49 (2016) 015004,
#        arXiv:1504.02085, Table 6 ("Bridges" column; same convention, their Sec. 1; they set b_0 = 0, we use b_0 = 1).
#  t_n : terminally attached walks (z(i) >= 0 for all i), n = 0..26: OEIS A116904 (Guttmann-Torrie / CCG 2016 Table 6;
#        the arXiv version of Table 6 has typos at n = 11, 12, per the OEIS entry; we take OEIS).
#        Relation with our strict half-space walks: h_{n+1} = t_n.
